harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured split-DNS authority: node1 (VyOS) answers app.internal -> node3's address (10.60.0.10) for lan-a clients via pdns_recursor + static-host-mapping on eth2 (10.60.0.1/24); node2 (OPNsense) answers app.internal -> node4's address (10.61.0.10) for lan-b clients via Unbound host-override on newly assigned opt1/vtnet2 interface (10.61.0.1/24) with a matching pass rule. Discovered topology via ARP/ICMP tcpdump probing (node1 eth2 <-> node3, node1 eth1 <-> node2 vtnet1 transit, node2 vtnet2 <-> node4), assigned static lan-a/lan-b addressing to node3/node4 via NetworkManager, and verified cross-side isolation (each router only answers for its own side). All 4 nodes were then restarted one at a time (native reboot), with boot-identity change and post-restart service/config recovery confirmed for each.
actions_performed: Mapped physical topology via ARP/ICMP tcpdump probing across all 4 nodes
Assigned static IPs: node1 eth2=10.60.0.1/24 (lan-a), node2 opt1/vtnet2=10.61.0.1/24 (lan-b), node3 enp8s0=10.60.0.10/24, node4 enp8s0=10.61.0.10/24
Configured VyOS node1: eth2 address, system static-host-mapping app.internal->10.60.0.10, dns forwarding listen-address/allow-from on lan-a, committed and saved

Configured OPNsense node2 via config.xml surgery: added opt1 interface assignment, filter pass rule for opt1, Unbound host override app.internal->10.61.0.10; applied via configctl interface reconfigure/filter reload/unbound restart
Verified DNS resolution locally on each router and from each lan client (node3 against node1, node4 against node2) using raw DNS queries (no dig/nslookup available)
Verified side isolation: node1 only serves lan-a mapping, node2 only serves lan-b mapping
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id/kern.boottime, interface state, DNS query) on all 4 nodes
Restarted node1, node3, node4 (native `reboot`) and node2 (FreeBSD `reboot`) one at a time, polling until exec access returned
Confirmed changed boot identity on all 4 nodes post-restart
Re-verified interface addressing, DNS service state, and end-to-end app.internal resolution on all nodes after each restart

tcpdump ARP capture confirmed node1 eth2<->node3 (lan-a) and node2 vtnet2<->node4 (lan-b); ICMP capture confirmed node1 eth1<->node2 vtnet1 transit link
